product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI is an AI-native performance and CX management platform built specifically for contact centers: it unifies contact center data (voice, chat, email, CRM, QA, WFM and more) and turns interactions into Auto QA, AI coaching and next-best actions for frontline teams and AI agents.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage headline ('AI-native performance and CX management platform') and About page description.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage (read in full) contains no pricing link; navigation routes to demos. An independent review confirms 'Its site has no pricing page and routes buyers to a demo.'

named_customers.notes: Sagility appears as a named customer story; Foundever, AFNI, AT&T and Uber appear on the BPO logo wall; Premier Bankcard, Discover and Progressive appear on the financial-services logo wall.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook lists 170 employees (2026), Tracxn 168 as of Aug 2026, TipRanks 193 as of Nov 2, 2026 - all within 101-200.

hq_location.notes: About page lists 'Plano Headquarters, 500 N Central Expy, Suite 500, Plano, TX 75074'; offices also in Miami and Hyderabad.

founded_year.notes: AmplifAI's own press release says 'Since its founding in 2018'; Indexed.vc profile also says founded 2018 (some directories list 2016 or 2020).

eng_blog.notes: Blog index categories are Coaching, Learning & Development, Software Buyer's Guides, AI Agents, Quality and Compliance, CX Insights, Industry News, Press, Company News - marketing/CX content only, no engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The homepage (read in full) has no docs, help-center or developer-portal link in its navigation. learn.amplifai.com exists but is a 'CX Learning Hub' of marketing guides and case studies, not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page is open and lists exactly one opening: Senior .Net Full Stack Developer (Plano) - no AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Open-source LLMs such as LLaMA, self-hosted internally within AmplifAI's own secure cloud rather than via public APIs like ChatGPT
model_provider.notes: Trust page: 'We use open-source LLMs like LLaMA hosted internally within our secure cloud. Your data never leaves our environment to reach public APIs like ChatGPT.'

compliance_certs.notes: Trust page lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI (Security Standards Council) and GDPR compliance; homepage badges repeat HIPAA, PCI, GDPR and ARC-AMPE. ARC-AMPE is not one of the five requested certifications and is excluded.

last_funding.notes: $33.7M Series B plus credit facility, announced September 23, 2025, led by CVS Health Ventures with LiveOak Ventures and Dallas Venture Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced 2025-09-23, which falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer (Product) opening; no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: AmplifAI 3.0 - a workforce orchestration platform uniting AI agents and human teams - was unveiled 'this quarter' per the company's launch post, updated November 10, 2026, well within the 6-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page team section is small (8 leaders plus 4 board members) and lists no start dates; the most recent verifiable C-level change is CFO Srini Palamarthy, who started 2025-10-01 per LinkedIn - about 13 months before 2026-11-09, just outside the 12-month window. No departures were announced.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live sales job posting says 'Familiar with managing and documenting the sales cycle with CRM tools. HubSpot is preferred'; the integrations page names Salesforce, Zendesk and ServiceNow among its CRM/service-desk integrations.
